_doc: More Candy Kingdom frosting decorations (bead bzc.124), the recipe of set candy-decorations (bead bzc.115, docs/art/classes/decorations.md): passable small details at 32 x 32 with the doodad class layer, impassable one-cell props on 64 x 64 with the prop class layer. generate-image-v2, no style image; one call returns many candidates of a mixed subject, the best distinct ones are accepted and cropped to their opaque box plus 1 px. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one tiny candy-land detail, each image a different one of these: a little heap of shiny jelly beans in pink, lemon, mint and orange; a small round peppermint-swirl lollipop #e03a3e and white stuck upright in the ground on a white stick; three candy corns with yellow, orange and white stripes; a round bonbon in shiny pink #e2589b wrapper twisted at both ends. Small and low, about half of the image wide, much smaller than a person.

Subject: one big blocking candy-land prop that fills one map cell, each image a different one of these: a giant round swirl lollipop of red #e03a3e and white planted upright on a thick white stick, as tall as a house; a giant scoop of strawberry ice cream #f08cb8 melting on an upturned waffle cone #d9a45a; a tall stack of three big macarons in pink, mint and lemon #f08cb8 #8fdcc0 #f4d46c. About three quarters of the image wide and tall.

recipes.concept: SMALL CANDY CREATURES AND PLANTS (passable, 1 cell; no loose sweets, which read as pickups)
recipes.subject: Subject: one tiny candy-land detail growing or living on the icing, each image a different one of these: a little marzipan snail with a pink #f08cb8 swirl shell, crawling; a small sugar-glass butterfly with pale mint #8fdcc0 wings resting on the ground; two red cherries #d8323c on one green stem lying on the ground; a little tuft of spun-sugar grass, pale pink and white. Small and low, about half of the image wide, much smaller than a person.
